title: Blue & Black or White & Gold? 👗
caption:
Same pixels. Different realities.

In 2015 one photo split the internet. 57% saw blue and black, 30% saw white and gold, because every brain assumes different light.

Which level broke your brain? 👇

#thedress #psychology #perception #stickman #reelsinstagram
